mechanism_narrative: A two-week improvement in TRANSIT and RETAIL_REC signals reopening momentum that lifts retail footfall over next four weeks.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than -30.9 (the last 28-day mean) despite t-0w improvement.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM crossing from negative to positive indicates reduced stockpiling and reopening, driving RETAIL_REC higher over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above 0% after being negative for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moved from -3.6 at t-1w to 0.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 14 days is lower than over last 14 days when GROCERY_PHARM crosses above zero.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES recovery combined with RESIDENTIAL decline indicates return to office, boosting weekday retail footfall and RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES improves by >2 points week-on-week while RESIDENTIAL falls by >2 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -33.7 to -30.7 while RESIDENTIAL fell from 18.9 to 14.4
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over next 28 days does not exceed last 28-day mean when WORKPLACES rises and RESIDENTIAL falls together.

mechanism_narrative: In post-lockdown winter reopening, PARKS rebound signals outdoor social activity that spills over into adjacent retail, lifting RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -40.4 to -34.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: In post-lockdown winter reopening, RETAIL_REC over next 14 days is lower than last 14-day mean despite PARKS recovery.

mechanism_narrative: Transit recovery from -72.7 to -64.7 reflects easing of stay-at-home orders, reducing retail constraints and raising RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by more than 5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next 14-day mean is not higher than last 14-day mean after TRANSIT improves >5 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: Decline in RESIDENTIAL from 18.9 to 14.4 signals workers leaving home, increasing weekday retail footfall and RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell to 14.4 at t-0w from 18.9 at t-1w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not higher than last 28-day mean when RESIDENTIAL falls below 15%.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains below -60% for two consecutive weeks, persistent avoidance of public transport suppresses retail activity, driving RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -60% for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than last 28-day mean even when TRANSIT stays below -60% for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, a fall in WORKPLACES below -35% predicts renewed stay-at-home orders that reduce retail and push RETAIL_REC lower over one week.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is -30.7 at t-0w, near threshold
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over next 7 days is not lower than last 7-day mean when WORKPLACES falls below -35%.
